## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff and mypy checks pass.
- [ ] Package build and metadata checks pass when packaging is affected.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] No token, credential, private endpoint, recording, dataset, cache, or personal data is included.

## Dependency and data impact

- [ ] New or changed dependencies list their exact source, version, license, purpose, and build scripts.
- [ ] Security, privacy, cache, token, redirect, media, and server-contract effects are described.

## DCO

- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by` line created with `git commit -s`, certifying the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1](../DCO).
